title: Feasibility and Acceptability of Offering Self-sampling to Non-attendees in Primary Care
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether human-papillomavirus (HPV) self-sampling can be used as a primary screening test for unscreened women.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* No previous cervical cancer screening test in the last three years

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancy
* previous hysterectomy
